title: StegSeed Instance
description: Represents an operationally real instantiation of a StegSeed Definition, substantiated at time t under admissibility conditions with a verifiable witness bundle.

instance_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this instantiated entity (immutable).

seed_id.description: Identifier of the seed definition from which this instance was created.

seed_version.description: The exact version of the seed definition used to substantiate this instance.

entity_type.description: Domain classification (must match the referenced seed definition entity_type).

substantiated_at.description: Time of substantiation (the boundary crossing from potential to actual).

substantiated_by.description: Actor and authority context that initiated substantiation.

actor_kind.description: Type of actor (human, ai_entity, system, inspector, fabricator, operator, etc.).

roles_asserted.description: Roles asserted by the actor at substantiation time (must be verifiable via witness bundle).

authority_ref.description: Optional reference to a separate authority/role activation instance that grants this actor permission.

admissibility_snapshot.description: A minimal, deterministic snapshot of admissibility evaluation inputs/outputs at substantiation time. This does not replace validation; it supports reconstruction.

evaluated_at.description: Timestamp when admissibility was evaluated (should match substantiated_at or be immediately prior).

decision.description: Recorded outcome of admissibility evaluation. Instances MUST NOT be created with decision=blocked.

conditions.description: The evaluated conditions (StegSeed Conditions DSL expressions) as they were applied at substantiation time.

world_state_refs.description: Optional references to world-state snapshots used for evaluation (hash-addressed, URI-based).

witness_bundle_ref.description: Reference to the witness bundle that proves admissibility and satisfies evidence obligations.

uri.description: Location of the witness bundle (file, repo, s3, vault, ipfs, etc.).

hash.description: Content hash of the witness bundle (or its manifest) for integrity.

status.description: Operational status of this instance. Changes in status are recorded via new admissible transitions (append-only).

supersedes_instance_id.description: If status is active and this instance supersedes a prior one, this points to the prior instance_id.

revocation.description: If status is revoked, provides linkage to the revocation transition (append-only).

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes. Must not be required for verification.
